meta_data.base_class: Retrieve the current temperature for a specified <country city>, given in degrees Celsius - <country city> refers to any city located within a specific nation-state for which real-time weather data (especially temperature) is available and queryable via public or proprietary data services.

tool_template.name: get<class>Temperature
tool_template.description: Retrieve the current temperature for a specified <class>.

timestamp.description: The Unix timestamp representing the specific date and time for which the <class> temperature is requested.

unit_preference.description: The preferred unit of temperature measurement. Options: 'Celsius', 'Fahrenheit'.

include_forecast.description: Whether to include a short-term weather forecast along with the current temperature for the <class>.

language.description: The language in which to return information, e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de'.
